title: 第24章 收益第25章 搏击术
content_zh:
喧嚣震天的雷龙安静了几秒钟。
观众们都傻眼了。
那个杀神黎骏，居然滚得这么熟练？
嘶，总感觉这一幕似曾相识……
随后，观众们齐刷刷的盯着陈冲，眼神震动不已。
他真的把黎骏也打败了？
出手必见血的“杀神”，居然被他打的滚落擂台、滚进通道？
观众们渐渐呼吸粗重，随后，不知是谁先嚎了一声，随后满场沸腾。
“陈冲！”
“陈冲！”
许多酒客高呼着陈冲的名字，当然，也有人是带着咬牙切齿的。
但这一场拳拳到肉的硬仗，显然让许多人觉得值了回票价。
陈冲看着黎骏“无意识”的滚走了，眼神有些错愕。
看人家这份丝滑，王力还需要向前辈多学习。
他捂着嘴咳了两声，摊开手一看，掌上是殷红的鲜血。
黎骏的拳头自然是极重的，比他更重。
如果不是有吞噬形态，在和黎骏互爆的过程中，他恐怕会先倒下。
而就算有这样的天赋，余下的劲力也震动了他的內腑，让他受了不轻的伤。
等会得多啃两支营养膏。
看着四周狂热的观众，陈冲淡然的朝他们挥了挥手，然后走下了擂台。

另一边的候场室，短发女子和彭维都在那里，沉默的透过气窗看向陈冲。
“居然赢了……还是这样赢的。”
半晌后，彭维有些艰难道。
“你输得不冤。”
女人眼中精光闪烁。
彭维默默点了点头。
女人缓缓脱下外套，里面是一件紧身运动胸罩，以及一条绷得紧紧的运动短裤，一双夸张的雪白长腿完全暴露在外。
她矫健的往外走去，语气带着战意
“有机会的话，我得跟他来一场。”
她拧开门，一名工作人员刚好站在外面伸手，愣了一下。
“哎？哦，裴丽，该你上场了。”
“嗯。”
包厢里。
周虎听着外面的喧嚣，露出一丝笑容
“老于，这次你们带回来个好苗子啊。”
于峰沉默着点了点头。
周虎瞥了他一眼，淡淡道
“既然他都打赢了黎骏，那之前的就算了。他的待遇现在先按黎骏的来，你去给他看看，看什么时候能进境界，我要跟他签约。”
于峰转回头看他
content_en:
The noisy Brontosaurus was quiet for a few seconds.
The audience was dumbfounded.
That God of Killing, Li Jun, is actually so skillful?
Hiss, I always feel like this scene seems familiar...
Afterwards, the audience all stared at Chen Chong with shock in their eyes.
Did he really defeat Li Jun?
The "God of Killing" who was bound to see blood when he struck was actually beaten down the ring and rolled into the passage?
The audience gradually began to breathe heavily, and then, someone didn't know who howled first, and then the whole place became excited.
"Chen Chong!"
"Chen Chong!"
Many drinkers chanted Chen Chong's name, and of course, some did so with gritted teeth.
But this hard-fisted fight obviously made many people feel that it was worth the price of admission.
Chen Chong watched Li Jun roll away "unconsciously" with a bit of shock in his eyes.
Looking at his smoothness, Wang Li still needs to learn more from his predecessors.
He covered his mouth and coughed twice, then opened his hand and saw bright red blood on his palm.
Li Jun's fist is naturally extremely heavy, heavier than him.
If he hadn't had the devouring form, he might have fallen first during the explosion with Li Jun.
Even with such talent, the remaining strength shocked his insides and caused him serious injuries.
I’ll take two more nutritious ointments later.
Looking at the enthusiastic audience around him, Chen Chong waved to them calmly and then walked off the stage.
In the waiting room on the other side, the short-haired woman and Peng Wei were both there, looking at Chen Chong through the transom in silence.
"I actually won... I still won like this."
After a while, Peng Wei said with some difficulty.
"You didn't lose unjustly."
The woman's eyes sparkled.
Peng Wei nodded silently.
The woman slowly took off her jacket, revealing a tight sports bra and a pair of tight sports shorts, completely exposing her exaggerated long white legs.
She walked out vigorously, with a fighting tone in her voice
"If I have a chance, I have to have a fight with him."
She opened the door, and a staff member stood outside and stretched out her hand, stunned for a moment.
"Huh? Oh, Pei Li, it's your turn."
"Yeah."
In the box.
Zhou Hu listened to the commotion outside and smiled.
"Lao Yu, you brought back a good seedling this time."
Yu Feng nodded silently.
Zhou Hu glanced at him and said lightly
"Since he has defeated Li Jun, let's forget about the previous one. His treatment will be according to Li Jun's for now. You go and show it to him and see when he can enter the realm. I want to sign a contract with him."
Yu Feng turned back to look at him
